#### `places_block` {#places_block}

<p class="fl-facts">required · block</p>

**The block hung on the side of a trunk.**

It must be a block type that carries both a cardinal-direction state and a growth state; without them nothing is placed. The direction written is the compass direction of the face the engine picked.

#### `allow_adjacent` {#allow_adjacent}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · boolean · absent: false</p>

**Lets a decoration be placed next to one that is already there.**

Off by default, which keeps decorations spaced out along a trunk.

#### `bark_side_only` {#bark_side_only}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · boolean · absent: false</p>

**Restricts placement to the bark faces of the log.**

Off by default, so the cut ends of a log are fair game unless you say otherwise.
